style: High Intensity Warning (Loss Aversion, Time Pressure)

visual_elements.composition: Visual flow emphasizes urgency and immediate loss.
visual_elements.text_style: Bold, condensed, high-contrast typography. Use #FF8C00 for key action words.

motion_guidelines.effect: Sharp cuts, screen shakes/flashes, aggressive zoom/pan effects to create urgency.

layout_structure.style: Large, flashing border/overlay using #FF8C00. Motion: Rapid pulse.
Red/Orange countdown timer or clock graphic. Motion: Rapid decrease.
Button shape using #FF8C00 with sharp edges. Motion: Quick pop-in or slide in.

image_generation_prompt.base_prompt: A hyper-realistic, high-contrast cinematic shot of a digital warning screen. Dominant colors are deep black (#1A1A1A) and intense orange (#FF8C00). Focus on extreme visual tension and urgency.
image_generation_prompt.text_overlay_instructions: Overlay the text using thick, aggressive sans-serif font. Key words must be in #FF8C00 and white for maximum impact.
image_generation_prompt.motion_description: Implement rapid (under 1 second) visual transitions between elements. Use glitch or flash effects to enhance the warning feeling.

final_output_summary: Thumbnail Concept 1 is finalized with an aggressive, loss-aversion design using #FF8C00 and extreme motion graphics for maximum click-through rate.
